# A jump out of a web wears down the web beside it (851-3501, docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip
# quirks/web-jump-wears-wrong-web. A staged scene (written by wiki-clips --replays from a scene spec,
# docs/wiki-media.md): it boots, loads this custom level from the title's load-level menu (240), and plays the
# scene's inputs from 241, its frame 0. The player (@) walks off a ledge into a shaft three blocks wide and falls
# to its foot, three webs (&) side by side at x 96, 112 and 128 (y 448):
#   1111111111111111111111
#   1000000011111111111111
#   1@00000011111111111111
#   1111100011111111111111
#   ...  (24 rows in all)
#   1111100011111111111111
#   11111&&&11111111111111
#   1111111111111111111111
#   1111111111111111111111
# He lands in the right-hand web (339) at x 133, near its left edge, and jumps every 8 frames from 371, fourteen
# times. characterStepEvent lets him jump because collision_point(x, y, oWeb) finds the web at his middle, x 128,
# but takes the strength off instance_place(x, y, oWeb), the first web his mask overlaps, in the order they were
# made. He has no mask of his own, so it's his sprite's frame: standing, it overlaps only his own web; falling, it
# reaches into the web at x 112 beside him too, which was made first.
# Of the fourteen jumps, eleven wear down the middle web (12 to 1, 379-475) and only three his own (12 to 9, 371,
# 403 and 443). The middle web breaks on the fourteenth (475), and his own still holds him; a single web breaks on
# the eleventh (web/fall). Ends at 510.
# story: oWeb.life=11@371..371 oWeb.life=9@443..443 oWeb.life=2@467..467 -oWeb@475..475 !-oWeb@..474
# story: !-oWeb@476.. !plife<4
